cases.name: Source-Aware Research Card
cases.purpose: Reference image-style report cards or long images with exact text and chart overlays.
cases.style: source-aware header, clear headline, key number block, 2-4 evidence blocks, boundary footer
cases.notes: AI-generated backgrounds may be used only as visual material behind exact Satori/Sharp text and charts.

cases.name: Photo Derived Editorial Diptych
cases.purpose: A photo-preserving editorial composition with a sparse relation-derived abstract panel and deterministic exact-text overlay.
cases.style: source-aware photo layer, uniform ivory panel, restrained relation marks, deterministic editorial title, and adaptive photo/panel geometry

score.qa: three representative source categories passed visual QA

applies_to: research-report covers and dividers without evidence-bearing body content
disabled_when: evidence-dense report-card bodies, dashboards, tables, charts, banker appendices, or regulatory pages
exact financial, source, compliance, or legal text inside generated imagery
unauthorized source photo or personal likeness
full-bleed cinematic portrait or photorealistic identity replacement
cases.notes: Reuse the relation-trace, geometry, panel-only generation, deterministic overlay, and QA contracts only. Personal photos, generated portrait panels, and project composites are not bundled.
cases.source_boundary: The upstream repository is a method-only reference with unknown license; no upstream code, prompt, example, or asset is bundled.
